content.text: ==3125137== Thread #1 is the program's root thread
==3125137==  Address 0x4b8de58 is 152 bytes inside a block of size 800 alloc'd
==3125137== Possible data race during write of size 8 at 0x4B8D358 by thread #5

==3125137==    by 0x366188: Stroika::Foundation::Execution::BlockingQueue<std::pair<Stroika::Foundation::Execution::Logger::Priority, Stroika::Foundation::Characters::String> >::AddTail(std::pair<Stroika::Foundation::Execution::Logger::Priority, Stroika::Foundation::Characters::String> const&, double)::{lambda()#1}::operator()() const (BlockingQueue.inl:34)

==3125137==    by 0x3689A2: void Stroika::Foundation::Execution::ConditionVariable<std::mutex, std::condition_variable>::MutateDataNotifyAll<Stroika::Foundation::Execution::BlockingQueue<std::pair<Stroika::Foundation::Execution::Logger::Priority, Stroika::Foundation::Characters::String> >::AddTail(std::pair<Stroika::Foundation::Execution::Logger::Priority, Stroika::Foundation::Characters::String> const&, double)::{lambda()#1}>(Stroika::Foundation::Execution::BlockingQueue<std::pair<Stroika::Foundation::Execution::Logger::Priority, Stroika::Foundation::Characters::String> >::AddTail(std::pair<Stroika::Foundation::Execution::Logger::Priority, Stroika::Foundation::Characters::String> const&, double)::{lambda()#1}) (ConditionVariable.inl:138)
==3125137== This conflicts with a previous read of size 8 by thread #4
==3125137==  Address 0x4b8d358 is 24 bytes inside a block of size 64 alloc'd
THis issue is minor - and worked around with helgrind suppression, but best if I can find a better way to mark my use of atomics as a lock in helgrind with the notification routines.
